story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Every great recipe starts with a little passion, and **Chaavdari** started with family, food, and an idea.
story.p2: Our story began with Mandar Kamble, a passionate chef with over **10+ years** of experience in the food industry. From creating delicious cookies and pastries for clients to running catering orders, Mandar always had a love for creating food that brought people together. Alongside his professional work, he also started taking small homemade snack orders from people around the neighbourhood. Seeing his talent and passion, we thought, why not turn this passion into something of our own?
story.p3: That simple idea brought together Mandar's recipes and culinary experience with our creativity, ideas, and vision.
story.p4: Our aim is simple 100% natural ingredients, authentic Konkan flavours, traditional recipes, and healthy homemade goodness made with love and ready to travel from our home to your doorstep, anywhere in the world. 🧡

origin.title: Our Origin & Workshop
origin.description: Every authentic recipe we make began right here on this veranda. This family home in at **Kapadgaon, Pali, Ratnagiri,** is where our journey started, crafting every product by hand using timeless Konkan traditions.
